verdict.rationale: Codegen documents an agent-permission setting that controls whether the agent can create pull requests, and states that agents can create new PRs with code changes. Supporting docs show the agent can create branches and commit code, and an API exists to set PR state such as draft or ready_for_review. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that PR creation fires automatically on task completion (the setting is framed as "in response to user requests"), any per-agent or per-trigger configuration of that behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
